invocations.note: The install probe (probeMlxServer) needs exit 0: a build whose --help fails installs on no Mac. The check also reads the flags from it.

probe.note: mlxProbePassed: exit 0 and argparse's usage line, case-insensitive. mlx-server has no --version (argparse exits 2): nothing ties the binary to its tag but the release it came from.

archive.note: probeMlxServer runs <unpacked archive>/mlx-server. The fork's release-atomic.yml packs exactly that file, and conf's mirror-mlx.yml refuses an archive holding anything else.

strings.note: Every chat with an MLX model is forwarded here.
